Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5050 Gaming PC – 16GB RAM, 500GB NVMe SSD

 Powerful 1080p Gaming PC with Intel and NVIDIA Performance

 The Intel Core i5-13400F RTX 5050 Gaming PC is built for gamers who want strong daily performance, smooth 1080p gaming, fast loading times, and a clean ARGB gaming look. This PC combines a modern Intel 13th Gen processor, a Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB graphics card, 16GB dual-channel DDR4 memory, and fast NVMe storage to deliver a balanced experience for gaming, multitasking, studying, office work, and entertainment.

 Processor Performance

 Intel Core i5-13400F – 10 Cores and 16 Threads

 At the heart of this system is the Intel Core i5-13400F , a 13th Generation processor designed with Intel hybrid architecture. It features 10 cores , including 6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores , with a total of 16 threads . This gives the PC strong performance for modern games, background applications, browsing, Discord, launchers, and productivity tasks.

 The processor can reach up to 4.60GHz Max Turbo Frequency and includes 20MB Intel Smart Cache , making it a powerful and reliable choice for a gaming PC in this category. Because this is an F-series processor , it does not include integrated graphics, which makes it ideal for builds that use a dedicated graphics card like the RTX 5050.

 Graphics Card

 Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB

 Graphics performance is powered by the Palit GeForce RTX 5050 Dual 8GB GDDR6 . This GPU is designed for modern 1080p gaming, offering NVIDIA RTX technologies, AI-powered graphics features, and support for modern display standards. The Palit RTX 5050 Dual comes with 8GB GDDR6 memory , 2560 CUDA cores , a 128-bit memory interface , and modern outputs including HDMI and DisplayPort.

 Dual-Fan Cooling Design

 The Palit Dual cooling design uses a compact dual-fan layout to help keep the graphics card cool during gaming sessions. Its clean black design, dual-slot size, and efficient cooling structure make it suitable for gaming systems where airflow, space, and reliability matter.

 Motherboard

 ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4

 The system is built on the ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4 , a micro-ATX motherboard using the Intel H610 chipset and LGA1700 socket . It supports Intel 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen processors, DDR4 memory, PCIe 4.0 for the graphics card, M.2 storage, SATA storage, Realtek Ethernet, USB connectivity, and essential ASUS protection features.

 Stable ASUS Protection Features

 ASUS PRIME motherboards are designed for stability and everyday reliability. This board includes practical protection and durability features such as ASUS 5X Protection III, DIGI+ VRM control, LANGuard, and SafeSlot Core, helping improve long-term system stability for gaming and daily use.

 Memory and Storage

 16GB Lexar THOR DDR4 RAM

 This PC includes 16GB Lexar THOR DDR4 RAM , installed as 2x8GB for dual-channel performance. Dual-channel memory helps improve system responsiveness and gaming performance compared to single-stick configurations. Lexar THOR DDR4 memory supports Intel XMP 2.0 and uses an aluminum heat spreader designed to help with airflow and heat dissipation.

 The RAM kit is listed as 3600MHz . However, because the ASUS PRIME H610M-K D4 officially supports DDR4 memory up to 3200MHz, the actual running speed may depend on BIOS settings, CPU memory controller support, and compatibility.

 Kingston NV3 500GB NVMe SSD

 Storage is handled by the Kingston NV3 500GB NVMe SSD , a fast PCIe NVMe drive designed for quick Windows boot times, faster game loading, and smoother everyday use. Compared to traditional hard drives, NVMe storage gives the system a much faster and more responsive feel when opening applications, launching games, transferring files, and using Windows.

 Cooling and Power

 DeepCool AG400 CPU Cooler

 The CPU is cooled by the DeepCool AG400 , a single-tower air cooler with a 120mm PWM fan and four heat pipes. This cooler is a strong upgrade over basic stock cooling

Intel Core i9-14900KF RTX 5070 12GB Gaming PC in Jordan

 The i9-14900KF RTX 5070 Gaming PC is a premium high-performance desktop designed for gamers and demanding users who want flagship Intel processing power, modern NVIDIA Blackwell graphics, DDR5 memory and fast PCIe 4.0 NVMe storage.

 This configuration combines the Intel Core i9-14900KF , ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI motherboard , 32GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 memory , Kingston NV3 1TB NVMe SSD , MSI MPG A850GS PCIE5 850W 80 PLUS Gold power supply , DeepCool LE720 360mm ARGB liquid cooler , and the Thermaltake MH1 Full Glass chassis with seven fans .

 The result is a powerful platform suitable for modern gaming, heavy multitasking, streaming, productivity, creative workloads and demanding everyday PC use.

 i9-14900KF RTX 5070 Gaming Performance

 Intel Core i9-14900KF Processor

 At the heart of this Gaming PC is the Intel Core i9-14900KF , a 14th Generation Intel Core desktop processor.

 Intel officially specifies the i9-14900KF with 24 total cores and 32 threads , consisting of 8 Performance-cores and 16 Efficient-cores . The processor can reach a maximum turbo frequency of 6.0GHz and includes 36MB of Intel Smart Cache . It uses the LGA1700 socket and supports DDR5 memory up to 5600 MT/s at Intel’s standard specification level.

 The i9-14900KF carries a 125W processor base power specification and is designed for high-performance desktop workloads. Because this is a KF-series processor , it does not include integrated processor graphics, so graphics output is handled by the dedicated RTX 5070.

 With 24 cores and 32 threads, this processor gives the system substantial resources for gaming while also handling streaming applications, browser tabs, productivity software and demanding multitasking.

 ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB

 Triple-Fan NVIDIA Blackwell Graphics

 Graphics performance is provided by the ASUS TUF Gaming GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 , standard model TUF-RTX5070-12G-GAMING .

 ASUS officially specifies 6,144 CUDA cores , 12GB GDDR7 memory , a 192-bit memory interface and 28Gbps memory speed. The standard model has a default Boost Clock of 2512MHz , while ASUS GPU Tweak III provides an optional 2542MHz OC Mode profile.

 The TUF card uses a large triple-fan design , measures 329 × 140 × 62.5mm , occupies approximately 3.125 slots and uses a single 16-pin power connector. ASUS recommends a 750W PSU for this card.

 This build uses an 850W Gold-rated MSI PSU, providing additional rated capacity above ASUS’s recommendation.

 The RTX 5070 platform supports current NVIDIA RTX technologies including DLSS, ray tracing and NVIDIA Reflex in compatible games and applications. Actual FPS will always vary according to resolution, graphics settings, driver version and individual game.

 MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI Motherboard

 Z790 DDR5 Platform with PCIe 5.0

 The system is built on the MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI , an ATX motherboard based on Intel’s Z790 chipset and LGA1700 socket.

 MSI officially supports compatible 12th, 13th and 14th Generation Intel Core processors , making this motherboard fully compatible with the i9-14900KF.

 The board features four DDR5 DIMM slots with capacity up to 256GB . MSI officially lists DDR5-6000 as a supported overclocked memory speed and supports Intel XMP 3.0 , making it an appropriate platform for the G.SKILL DDR5-6000 memory used in this system.

 For graphics expansion, the main PCIe slot supports PCIe 5.0 x16 directly from the CPU.

 Storage expansion is particularly strong, with four M.2 slots supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 drives plus six SATA 6Gb/s connectors. This gives plenty of room for future SSD upgrades beyond the installed Kingston NV3.

 Networking includes Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6E and Bluetooth 5.3 , providing both fast wired and wireless connectivity.

 32GB G.SKILL DDR5 6000 RAM

 High-Speed DDR5 Memory

 This Gaming PC includes 32GB of G.SKILL DDR5 memory rated at 6000 MT/s .
